headline: Binance Intake Falls To 517.4 Million Dollars From 881.8 Million As Exchange Intake Drops To 695.1 Million
narrative: Binance clean-asset intake fell to 517.4 million dollars from 881.8 million, and intake across 79 exchanges fell to 695.1 million dollars from 1,091.5 million, equal to 0.2564 percent of the 271.1 billion dollars held on those venues, compared with 0.4023 percent on the prior reading. A positive pipe is dollars arriving on the venue and a negative pipe is dollars leaving, measured as the 24-hour change in holdings excluding each exchange's own token. Bitfinex intake rose to 173.3 million dollars from 132.8 million, while Bitget intake fell to 0.8 million dollars from 73.0 million.
author: jordan
